The string `comment.created` appears in 15 files. I searched the whole working directory with a fixed-string grep, excluding `node_modules` and `.next`. Three further matches (`src/server/repositories/comment-repository.ts`, `src/components/domain/comment/comment-thread.tsx`, `src/components/domain/comment/comment-item.tsx`) are only `comment.createdAt`, a different property, so I left them out.

Two of the files are type and schema declarations (`src/types/event.ts`, `src/schemas/webhook.ts`), and `src/schemas/activity.ts` and `src/types/activity.ts` also list the name. The rest are emitters (`src/server/services/comment-service.ts`, `src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts`), subscribers (activity, search, webhook, and notification services), a display label map, and tests.

ANSWER: src/types/activity.ts, src/types/event.ts, src/schemas/activity.ts, src/schemas/webhook.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, src/server/services/notification-service.ts, src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts, src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts, tests/server/domain-events.test.ts, tests/services/comment-service.test.ts, tests/services/notification-service.test.ts, tests/services/activity-service.test.ts
